letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my forever cutie,  
Each sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. As the calendar flips to another day in late October, I find my heart still racing like the first time we said “I do” on 23 Feb 2025. Your laughter is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise. Thank you for turning ordinary moments into endless love stories—here’s to countless more chapters together.
poem:
In desert sands or city rain,  
Your love’s the rhythm in my vein.  
From sunrise glow to moonlit tide,  
With you, my heart forever rides.
